content: One of our key contributions is the derivation of a closed-form expression for this Jacobian. The next proposition provides such an expression, enabling entmax layers with adaptive $\alpha $. To the best of our knowledge, ours is the first neural network module that can automatically, continuously vary in shape away from softmax and toward sparse mappings like sparsemax.
